svg.aria-label: Building section for a fire on F19
svg.title: Building section for a fire on F19
svg.text: Building section, fire on F19 (F19-E): SYNTHETIC tower, 32 floors
DECISION SUPPORT ONLY: alarms, sprinklers, smoke control and elevators run on their own listed controls. Humans decide.
West to east cut through Stair A, the west office, the core (shafts and elevators), the east office and Stair B.
ROOF: helicopter landing or equivalency (SYNTHETIC); stairs reach the roof
F19: fire floor: voice alarm, relocate
F18: alert: voice alarm, relocate; hose connection, Stair B landing
F17: fire department staging; FD leaves the elevator here
F01: fire command center, battery room ESS-1; passenger cars recalled only if a lobby or hoistway detector activates
green: occupants go down Stair A (evacuation stair, suggested)
orange: fire department climbs Stair B; square = standpipe hose connection at F18
purple dashed: fire service elevator in Phase II (fire department only)
grey dotted: smoke may rise in shafts (stack effect); blue: firefighting water moving down (water graph)
dots: stair camera every 5th landing (an LAFD Req. 10 option); rings: person needing help (SYNTHETIC)
